pieces.name: Meadow birch A
pieces.notes: Single slender white trunk with dark bark flecks, light airy canopy in 4 to 5 yellow-green clumps, open gaps to the sky. Spring fresh green, autumn yellow, winter bare.

pieces.name: Meadow birch B
pieces.notes: Twin trunk forking low, taller and narrower than A, canopy clumps staggered up both stems.

pieces.name: Orchard tree A (apple)
pieces.notes: Short gnarled twisting trunk, round dome canopy with white and pale pink blossom clumps over green (spring); green with small fruit in summer. A few stones at the root.

pieces.name: Orchard tree B (pear)
pieces.notes: Like A but leaning trunk and slightly taller, denser pink blossom. Pear variant of the orchard pair.

pieces.name: Landmark oak A
pieces.notes: Lone broad oak: very thick buttressed trunk with exposed roots over a small mound and stones, low wide-spreading limbs, broad flat crown of clumped olive-to-yellow-green masses, wider than tall.

pieces.name: Landmark oak B
pieces.notes: Rounder, more compact crown than A, trunk splits into three main limbs, small hollow knot on the trunk.

pieces.name: Wildflower drift
pieces.notes: Low mound of grass with white daisies, yellow buttercups, pink clover and tall soft-violet lupin spikes rising at the back. Cards; the brightest colour on the isle.

pieces.name: Flowering bush
pieces.notes: Round bush of clumped leaves with white and pink wild-rose flowers, a pale stone at the foot.

pieces.name: Hedgerow, 4 m
pieces.notes: Modular straight run, 4 m: dense clumped yellow-green leaf mass, a few small violet flowers and stones at the foot. Ends soft so runs butt together.

pieces.name: Standing stone
pieces.notes: Weathered cream limestone menhir, tapering and slightly leaning, carved spiral and star sigil on the front face, ivy climbing one side, grass and pebbles at the base.

pieces.name: Dry-stone wall, straight 2 m
pieces.notes: Modular low field wall, 2 m: three to four courses of rough pale cream blocks, moss on the top course, a few fallen stones. Sheet draws a longer, stepped-down run; build it as 2 m pieces.

pieces.name: Dry-stone wall, corner
pieces.notes: Modular L corner, 2 m legs, same courses as the straight wall; the corner post courses stand one block higher.

pieces.name: Long grass tuft
pieces.notes: Arching long blades with a few seed heads, yellow-green tips; isle edges and wild ground.

pieces.name: Short grass tuft
pieces.notes: Low mown-grass tuft for towns and safe isles.

pieces.name: Clover patch
pieces.notes: Flat trefoil leaves with white clover heads.

pieces.name: Flower clump
pieces.notes: Small clump: yellow buttercups, white daisies, two violet lupin spikes.

pieces.name: Limestone rock A
pieces.notes: Large rounded boulder, pale warm cream with soft weathering, yellow lichen and moss on top.

pieces.name: Limestone rock B
pieces.notes: Low layered slabs, stacked flat beds with square edges.

pieces.name: Limestone rock C
pieces.notes: Cluster of upright pointed shards around one tall spike.

pieces.name: Limestone rock D
pieces.notes: Low dome, heavily mossed on top.

pieces.name: Limestone rock E
pieces.notes: Flat cluster of small blocks half sunk in turf. (Sheet label is misspelt 'Limetone'.)

pieces.name: Limestone lip / ledge
pieces.notes: Isle edge segment ~8 m: rounded turf cap with grass and a few flowers over a band of pale cream limestone blocks, ivy and grass hanging over the face. Turf top at y = 3; tiles side by side along the edge.

pieces.name: Limestone underside taper
pieces.notes: Inverted wedge of pale layered limestone tapering to a point, cool teal in the shade, turf rim on top, ivy curtains and long hanging roots.

pieces.name: Sky-pond edge
pieces.notes: Oval reflecting pond: soft grass rim, a few stones, lily pads and reeds. Water surface is a separate plane.

pieces.name: Stream channel
pieces.notes: Short shallow stream bed with rounded stones on both banks, runs from the pond to the lip.

pieces.name: Waterfall off the lip
pieces.notes: Thin fall from the stream mouth over the lip, ribbon cards turning to mist at the bottom.
